authors: Rayford G. Anthony, John J. McKetta
journal: Journal of Chemical and Engineering Data 12(1), 21-28
title: Phase Equilibrium in the Ethylene-Ethane-Water System
experimental_method: Flow-type two-phase equilibrium apparatus (McKetta group design) with vapor of fixed ethane/ethylene composition; water in the vapor and hydrocarbon in the water-rich liquid analyzed by sampling and chromatography.
uncertainties_stated: Pressure +-0.2% or +-0.5 psia whichever greater; temperature +-0.1 F at 100 and 160 F, +-0.2 F at 220 and 280 F; mole fraction total hydrocarbon in water +-5.0% of value; mole fraction water in vapor +-4.6% of value; chromatographic analysis +-0.5 mole per cent.
quality_remarks: Table I contains printed oddities kept unaltered: data row 102 (T 219.9, P 2012.2) has dry-basis ethane 0.2587 and ethylene 0.9413 (sum 1.2; probable misprint, ethylene perhaps 0.7413); row 'T 219.8, P 503.9' has ethane in water 0.9797 greater than the total 1.077 minus ethylene 0.9790 (sum is 1.9587 vs printed total 1.077); several other ethane/ethylene/total rows do not sum (e.g. 219.8 K 503.2: 0.9219+0.9090 vs 1.001; 219.9/4009.7: 0.5425+2.4124 vs 1.955). Printed totals appear to be the measured total hydrocarbon; ethane and ethylene columns are derived from total and vapor composition and may carry misprints. Ethane in water at 100 F, 1080.2 psia (0.8810) with ethylene 0.0030 ok. Text compares binary points with Reamer et al.

not_extracted_tables.Table IV: modified Henry's law constants and partial molal volumes derived by the authors from Table I

row_counts: Table I printed 116 data rows (71 on p.22, 45 on p.23), written 116 (no label rows); Table III printed 20, written 20 (blank T cells kept blank)
changes_after_image_check: none; every row compared visually with the page image, text layer matched
extraction_notes: Table I: 'No liquid sample taken' -> three liquid-phase cells empty (14 rows); printed -0- written 0. Table I also contains the 280 F data. Column headers rewritten ASCII (deg F -> F). Table I decimal points in the printed image are plain. Third value column value3 used for ethylene in water. Sanity: T within 99.8-280.0 F; P 298-5027 psia; water in vapor decreases with P at each T; replicate-like rows (e.g. 100.0, 1000.7) differ in composition.
